gates.observed_pattern: Legacy reel UI contains teaser styling and suspense mechanics inherited from the slot prototype.
gates.required_state: Reel timing, audio, haptics and narrative suspense are independent of near-win or near-bonus outcomes.

gates.observed_pattern: Bonus-mode architecture can continue rounds automatically.
gates.required_state: Every value-bearing round requires deliberate player initiation.

gates.observed_pattern: Legacy UI includes a compact buy-feature control inherited from the slot design.
gates.required_state: Feature-buy is disabled in the baseline welfare-first build and cannot bypass shared risk/session gates.

gates.observed_pattern: Mythic and celestial presentation is tightly coupled to gambling state and reward presentation.
gates.required_state: No paid action is described as sacrifice, blessing, redemption, destiny, divine judgement, charity, spiritual rank or moral progress.

gates.observed_pattern: Narrative state and game state currently coexist in one single-file application.
gates.required_state: Theme/narrative state cannot alter RTP, RNG, volatility, eligibility, limits, risk decisions or accounting.

gates.observed_pattern: Balance and stake are visible, but complete elapsed-time, total-staked, total-returned and net-session accounting is not the primary persistent truth surface.
gates.required_state: Persistent factual session truth remains visible above narrative persuasion.

gates.observed_pattern: Future social-impact layer does not yet have an enforced separation from wagering UX.
gates.required_state: Impact totals and beneficiaries cannot be used to prompt deposit, increase stake or extend play.

gates.observed_pattern: Legacy game path lacks a unified shared safety decision surface.
gates.required_state: Eligibility/limits/self-exclusion/risk decision executes before any value-bearing round and before persuasive narrative feedback.
